Hey everyone, I’m now actively working on improving the game. As always, thanks to all of you who continue to support me and those who help out on the Discord server. I want you to know that I’m aware of the issues related to multiplayer and I’m working on them. notes.title: 1.3 UPDATE! - NEW GRAPHICS SETTINGS!
notes.content:
Hey guys, it's been a while since I last updated the game, I'm sorry about that... Today I'm bringing you an update that many people have requested. 

Finally, I'm giving you a settings menu worthy of a AAA Game like Maurice: In The Predator's Nest. After hearing complaints like: "it’s a headache only being able to run 5 feet before my eyes turn off and I turn into Velma from Scooby Doo" about the game's motion blur, I've decided to lower it a bit. Still, if you don't like it, you have the freedom to disable it in the graphics settings. 

Honestly, I will never get tired of thanking all of you who support the game and give me suggestions to improve it. Also, thanks to those who have shown your love by buying some in-game skins. With the money raised, I can almost pay for 2 months of university. You guys are AWESOME!!!

[h2]Update notes:[/h2]

[h3]Added:[/h3]

[b]- New Graphics Settings:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43216470/98c807b8d01055e14227c25fa94c9490511a3fdc.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Enable DLSS

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43216470/2f01a05ad6ac6a9373a26c7a2d23dcad17a835de.png[/img]

If your graphics card supports DLSS, you can activate and deactivate this option.

This is my first time using DLSS, so if there are any bugs, I'd love for you to report them on Discord.

[url=https://discord.gg/mG43Uybt]Link to Discord[/url]

[*] Large quantity of quality options

 - Texture Quality
 - Material Quality
 - Render Distance
 - Level of Detail
 - Anti-Aliasing Mode
 - SMAA Anti-Aliasing Quality (Only when you are using SMAA)
 - Cast Shadows Toggle
 - Shadow Resolution

[*] Volumetrics

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43216470/873aa6a165611b7ae0613c363499b1391ad49185.png[/img]

[*] Post-process options

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43216470/59b5521ed54849204d331607949b62e1fdd7b9ce.png[/img]

[/list]

[b]- Other:[/b]

[list]
[*] Now, when you are the host of a custom game, instead of leaving the game, you end the game so that XP is saved for all players.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]

- Fixed low keycard spawn rate on Death Valley map. (Thanks to Mihhnea pro for the report.)

- XP when you press the Hit button near the corpse while the end-game animation plays. (Thanks to Winner2806 for the report.)

notes.title: NEW MAP! - DEATH VALLEY NOW AVAILABLE!!! - NEW CHARACTER!!!
notes.content:
[h1]NEW MAP:[/h1]

Venture into the heart of the wilderness with "[b]Death Valley[/b]". The latest map to challenge the bravest adventurers in Maurice: In the Predator's Nest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43216470/e80d063e7d8d0e12f76ce6973f330acbd21dbeb8.png[/img]

This expansive landscape is a treacherous swamp pine forest, teeming with dense, untamed vegetation that whispers secrets of the untold dangers lurking within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43216470/189e3d0bf1630d1f3a41b49694b6ed0c96c1a29e.png[/img]

With every step, "Death Valley" promises to keep your heart racing and your senses on edge, making it a thrilling addition to the game that will captivate and challenge players like never before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43216470/6e33ef4d8efcaa2bf57a175ec96a3fbab8880d91.png[/img]

[h1]NEW SURVIVOR:[/h1]

Meet the alligator hunter...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43216470/ed773a95306b22e3683a841e3e5c19da4b448704.png[/img]

Sporting an impressive white moustache that reflects his wisdom and years in the field.

This brother is easily recognizable even from a distance. His choice of headgear, a meticulously chosen fishing hat with a blend of natural camouflage colors, not only serves as a practical accessory for his hunting endeavors but also complements his rugged outdoor persona.

[h1]PATHC CONTENT:[/h1]

[h3]Added:[/h3]

- Carnotaurus now is able to jump

- New map "Death Valley"

- New survivor "Alligator Hunter"

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]

- Audio volumes balanced

- Set escape time in single player mode to 20 minutes

[h2]LUCAS YAPPING:[/h2]

Guys, I couldn't be happier with the reception that MauriceITPN Remake is getting. I receive so many messages congratulating me on the game, and for me, seeing these types of messages is priceless... Really, THANK YOU!

I hope you like this new map and enjoy it as much as I enjoyed developing it.

I'm sending a big hug to all of you, you are the best community that exists.

notes.title: FIXED 90% OR MORE GPU USAGE!
notes.content:
What's up guys, today talking to an old video game development professor of mine about why people said that my game could mine cryptocurrency, he gave me the answer... I made a stupid mistake of not limiting the fps... Within the environment game development, it seems to be quite obvious but I made the mistake of thinking that Unity did it automatically. So the game was always without fps limit, that's why almost 100% use of the GPU, even if you had the best graphics on the market.

[h3]Now you can limit the FPS to your liking!!![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43216470/c9cb5940454f998693211add60ddd228f9dd2f79.png[/img]

notes.title: I NEED SOME FEEDBACK FELLAS!
notes.content:
[h1]HELLO GUYS![/h1]

Thank you everyone for the beautiful messages you send me about the game, you make me very happy. As many of you already know, I'm just one person working on this project while studying a university degree, so my time is very limited and I don't have time to dedicate much to testing the game. So it's great that you put here all the errors and improvements that you can see in the game.

[h2]Matchmaking[/h2]

[h3]What do you think about the new matchmaking update?  [/h3]

I'll  proceed to tell boring programmer stuff so that you know that this has improved... If you want you can skip this part.

Right now there are 2 types of lobby in the game, the coop lobby and the multiplayer lobby, each lobby contains only the rooms dedicated to that game mode, when you press find game button the game executes a method that looks for a random room, if can't find it create one, this solves all the problems of finding a game and helps to optimize the traffic of players in the game.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[h3]What do you think about the gameplay?  And the new singleplayer/coop mode?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43216470/8a3662a3760ddac74d671e0cb5f233882496cb2c.png[/img]

Many of you have told me some problems related to this and I am working to solve them.

Some of these problems are:

[list]
[*] Annoying hitboxes
[*] Difficult to understand how to escape
[*] The predator can drop / kill players through walls, so the survivor can go off the map
[*] Very little vision for the survivor
[*] The predator stamina system is a bit buggy
[/list]

[h3]What do you think about the new quick-time event? 
Do you think it should be more difficult?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43216470/1854a4ab381c04ebd57ccef9f2278d38b5e4a81d.gif[/img]

[h3]Also a couple of people have asked me if my game mines crypto due the high GPU requirement...[/h3]

This is because I am not an expert in game optimization, and since Maurice: In The Predator's Nest uses highly polygonal models, the GPU has to work harder than in other games.

I don't know what kind of people is capable of deceiving their players like that, but if they have asked me, unfortunately, it is because it has ever happened in a game that luckily I have not played...

I doubt steam would have approved my game if it were to mine crypto coins...

[h3]Really thank you all guys[/h3]

-Fixed randomly dying in coop mode

[h3]Non-Gameplay[/h3]

-Fixed not finding game while matchmaking

[h3]More information[/h3]

I have read many comments about proximity chat sometimes not working, I have been looking at what was happening and I have realized that the servers that Maurice: In The Predator's Nest uses for voice chat, do not support the player traffic that the game is having at the moment...

I will try to solve this as soon as possible, although for the moment improving these servers is an expense that I cannot afford right now, I am very sorry, I really hope that you I can try to find a way to do it.

Thank you all!
